verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Mukama bwe yamgamba nti
Kye nkuwa kya buwa;
Amazzi g'obulamu,nywa,
Ggwe-alumiddwa-ennyonta;
Ne nnywa amazzi-ago,
Ne nzikuta;-omwoyo gyange
Ne gufuna-amaanyi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Mukama bwe yamgamba nti
Ensi-eno-ekutte nnyo;
Tunuulira nze,ofune
Omusana bulijjo;
Ne mutunuulira Yesu,
Ye ye njuba yange:
So saagala njuba ndala
Kunjakiranga nze.
